hypothesis: The measured all-head action change may be approximately reconstructed from separately measured head effects; quantify residual nonadditivity before proposing a real joint intervention.
adaptation: unchanged inference artifacts; no model loaded
action_expert: native expert layer1 projected K heads
dataset: existing train40/dev5 frame-zero full50 and first1, four saved noises
metrics: for every action group/view/window/space and noise: actual all-head delta energy; sum-single-head reconstruction residual energy ratio and cosine; additive head1+2 proxy error (not measured joint output); gap to actual all-head output
approximate_additivity_rule: residual energy/full delta energy <=0.10 and cosine>=0.95 in each of four noises; denominator zero gives null, never automatic pass
next_step: If approximate additivity fails, do not sum causal fractions or use linear proxy to choose a joint intervention; real head1+2 and complementary intervention remains separately required. If it passes, only call the first-order approximation adequate for this endpoint, never actual joint success.
stop: Any input SHA, exact target/noise, finite, shape, arithmetic identity or resource failure stops analysis. Preserve outputs; no GPU escalation.
